description: Defines the ResourceDefinition class for managing resource metadata and rendering HTML tags for scripts, styles, and links within the OrchardCore resource management system.

classes.name: ResourceDefinition
classes.description: Represents a resource with properties such as URL, dependencies, version, and methods to generate HTML tags for inclusion in views.

methods.name: SetAttribute
methods.description: Sets an attribute key-value pair for the resource.

methods.name: SetBasePath
methods.description: Sets the base path for the resource URL.

methods.name: SetUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL and optional debug URL for the resource.

methods.name: SetCdn
methods.description: Sets CDN URLs and supports SSL flag.

methods.name: SetCdnIntegrity
methods.description: Sets the integrity hash for CDN resources.

methods.name: SetVersion
methods.description: Sets the version of the resource, validating format.

methods.name: ShouldAppendVersion
methods.description: Indicates whether to append version to resource URL.

methods.name: SetCultures
methods.description: Sets supported cultures for the resource.

methods.name: SetInnerContent
methods.description: Sets inner HTML content for inline styles.

methods.name: SetPosition
methods.description: Sets the position of the resource in load order.

methods.name: GetTagBuilder
methods.description: Generates an HTML tag builder for including the resource based on settings.

methods.name: FindNearestCulture
methods.description: Finds the closest matching culture from the supported list.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Overrides equality based on Name, Type, and Version.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on Name and Type.
